items.note: Rule reproduced: up since the 2021-06 CHoCH (50 monthly bars). Chart: inside those 50 bars the monthly fell from 299 (2023-10) to 167.41 (2025-03), -44%, through monthly LH 289.5, LH 248, LL 188.85, LH 225, LL 167.41. The state never flipped because the protected low was the 2023-01 low of 128.25. Monthly is up since the 2025-05 break, but '50 bars up' hides an 18-month downtrend.

2025-05 closed at 233.14, above the 2024-12 swing high of 225, so this is a valid BOS by v1's state machine. On the chart it follows a LH/LL sequence from 299 down to 167.41, so an analyst would label the break of the 225 LH a CHoCH (reversal), not a continuation BOS.
167.41 (2025-03) is the lowest low between the broken 225 swing (2024-12) and the 2025-05 break bar.
Sweep definition not frozen. Real event: 2025-07 high 280 > 278.99 (the June high), close 231.0, a large bearish reversal month.

2025-W20 closed at 231.24, above the protected high of 225 (2024-W50).

W, Q and the M money zone reproduce exactly. Two small mismatches: M VPOC 210.8 (I get a flat top at 211.0-211.6, where nearest-to-middle gives 211.6) and Y MZ POC 212.8 (I get 213.0, with 55 vs 54 TPOs). missing.note: The 2025-07-18 LH before the August breakdown, the level a D reversal must reclaim. The read's protected high is the 280 range top.
The 08-14 and 08-26 lows, which launched the September rally. Shown only as a D sweep; it isn't a zone.
The 09-01..09-05 base under the 09-08 range-expansion bar (225.27 -> 248.88). It's the nearest real demand below price. v1 only builds W/M zones.
The pullback low inside the 167-280 up-leg. Price closed below it in W31, which an SMC reader would treat as the weekly warning sign. v1's zig-zag dropped it.

overall_note: Structure, pivots, profiles and the daily layer reproduce under v1, apart from one-bucket POC ties. But the M state calls an 18-month, -44% monthly decline part of an 'up for 50 bars' trend, D's protected high is the range top rather than the lower high that matters, and every HTF zone from 132 to 348 is 'strong', so the zone lines don't separate real levels from formula clutter.
